title: Reject an inference or deny a guarantee

variants.label: わけではない · correct a conclusion

segments.role: わけではない rejects the conclusion that a high price guarantees durability. It need not deny that some expensive items last well. In this generalization context, it overlaps substantially with とは限らない; the contrast is how the speaker frames the correction.

example.translation: A high price does not mean an item will always last a long time.
example.note: Someone has treated an expensive price as proof of durability; you correct that conclusion.

variants.change: わけではない rejects the conclusion that a high price guarantees durability. It need not deny that some expensive items last well. In this generalization context, it overlaps substantially with とは限らない; the contrast is how the speaker frames the correction.

variants.label: とは限らない · allow exceptions

segments.role: とは限らない denies that the rule holds without exception. Here it can replace わけではない with a closely related meaning. The overlap has limits: 嫌いなわけではない can reject “I dislike it” as an explanation; 嫌いだとは限らない instead leaves that dislike uncertain rather than straightforwardly denying it.

example.translation: Expensive items do not necessarily last a long time.
example.note: You warn a shopper that price alone is not a reliable rule.

variants.change: とは限らない denies that the rule holds without exception. Here it can replace わけではない with a closely related meaning. The overlap has limits: 嫌いなわけではない can reject “I dislike it” as an explanation; 嫌いだとは限らない instead leaves that dislike uncertain rather than straightforwardly denying it.

question: What can you safely conclude from either sentence about expensive items?
answers: Price alone does not guarantee durability; some expensive items may still last well.
Every expensive item wears out quickly.
The speaker has proved that cheaper items always last longer.
feedback: Both versions reject the blanket guarantee. Neither says that every expensive item is poor or that every cheaper item is better. わけではない also has explanatory-correction uses that do not freely substitute with とは限らない.
